name: Rock Gnome
reviewNotes: Approved final Rock Gnome biological package: shared Tremorsense configured for earth or stone, Natural Climber (15-foot Climb Speed), and one permanent Natural Trickster spell choice with one free casting per Long Rest.

Trial allocation: shared Gnome 9, configured Tremorsense 4, Natural Climber 2, Natural Trickster 2, source-bound spellcasting Ability 1; total 18/18. The same 60-foot range and use schedule are preserved for Dwarves and Rock Gnomes.
